title: ISRAELI KNESSET ELECTIONS 2013: campaigns heat up as hopefuls hit Israel's TV screens
description: Israel's election campaign has entered the home stretch with the start of a two-week period of televised political advertisements leading up to the January 22 vote. The state-subsidised blocs of adverts give Israeli political hopefuls a final chance to attack front-running Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu who enjoys a firm lead in opinion polls.
label: not-ai
